faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Abbotsford: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 2 bedroom condos sell for in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Abbotsford, 350 sold over the past year at a median of $405,000, with the middle half between $335,250 and $461,125.

faq.q: How fast do 2 bedroom condos sell in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median was 36 days, and homes sold for 96.5% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in Abbotsford do most 2 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Central, with 219 of the 350 sales at a median of $415,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Abbotsford have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Regency Park (16 sales, median $445,000); Evergreen Village (10 sales, median $282,500); Waterleaf (9 sales, median $495,000); La Galleria (7 sales, median $577,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Abbotsford was $465 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Abbotsford compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Abbotsford sold for $80,050 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($405,000 against $324,950, 90 sales). The strata fee was $465 a month against $300.
A 2 bedroom condo in Abbotsford sold for $113,750 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($405,000 against $518,750, 26 sales). The strata fee was $465 a month against $515.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Abbotsford has the second lowest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
